notes.title: Update Labyrinthum - 0.8.1.0
notes.content:
Dear [b]Labyrinthum[/b] adventurers,

We're delighted to present you with an update that will enhance your gaming experience in our exciting world of labyrinths! Here's what's new and improved:

[u]Recovering Wrong Answer Data[/u]

When you encounter a question for the first time and answer incorrectly, we'll collect your answer data to improve our content and personalize your experience.

[u]Link Discord Directly in Game[/u]

Join our Labyrinthum Discord community directly from the game to chat, share tips and meet other enthusiasts.

[u]Report Question button[/u]

If you find an answer incorrect or badly worded, you can now use the "Report Question" button and add a description of up to 500 characters to help us improve our content.

[u]Portal room redesign[/u]

The Portal Room has been completely redesigned for smoother navigation and an improved visual experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44462679/18b2011487804bd2adfac1efbfa26d972e8a39bd.png[/img]

[u]Capital/Country problem in the Geo Room[/u].

We have corrected the problems related to capital and country issues in the Geo Room for a more accurate experience.

[u]Free movement in Labyrinths[/u]

Enjoy a new freedom of movement in the labyrinths for a more immersive exploration.

[u]Report an Error on an In-Game Question[/u]

You can now report an error on a question directly in-game for faster feedback.

[u]Increased distance to click on countries/cities[/u].

We've enlarged the area for clicking on countries/cities in the Geo Room for greater precision.

[u]Information on the "E" Validation Button[/u]

We've added a notification explaining that the validation button is "E" and included this information in the options.

[u]Error: Parchment safekeeping in the event of a room jump[/u]

The scroll is no longer kept when you press the button to skip the room with the chairs.

This update will make your journey through [b]Labyrinthum[/b] even more exciting and rewarding. Update your game now and get ready for exciting new intellectual adventures!

notes.title: Labyrinthum is now available !
notes.content:
We are delighted to announce that [b]Labyrinthum[/b] is now available!

[b]Labyrinthum[/b] is much more than just a maze, it's an immersive experience that combines the fun of gaming with the stimulation of your brain through exciting preset themes. Discover a whole new world of challenges and discoveries through the following themed mazes:

Math 
History 
World Food 
Geography 
Technology 
Physics-Chemistry 
And lots more...

Each maze is filled with question boxes specially designed to match your chosen theme. These visually stimulating puzzles will allow you to test your knowledge, solve problems and take on exciting challenges as you explore the labyrinth.

Whether you're a math enthusiast, history buff, curious foodie, budding globetrotter, technophile or science lover, [b]Labyrinthum[/b] has something for everyone.

Immerse yourself in the captivating world of [b]Labyrinthum[/b] now and see if you have what it takes to reach the exit of each labyrinth by solving all the riddles linked to the chosen theme. Get ready to challenge your mind, learn new things and have more fun than ever before.

notes.title: Labyrinthum soon available!
notes.content:
Welcome to the captivating world of [b]Labyrinthum[/b]! Get ready to plunge into a spellbinding adventure as the long-awaited game prepares to make its Early Access debut on Friday, September 1, 2023.

As the countdown draws to a close, players around the world will finally be able to immerse themselves in this immersive gaming experience. In this early access version, you'll discover much of what makes [b]Labyrinthum[/b] such a unique game. Prepare to be enchanted by innovative gameplay elements and immerse yourself in a maze of intellectual challenges.

One of the most fascinating aspects of this version is the presence of over 2000 unique questions, carefully crafted to test your skills, logic and creativity. Every decision you make in [b]Labyrinthum[/b] could affect your progress, creating a dynamic and personalized gaming experience.

Early Access marks the start of an exciting journey for developers and players alike, so get ready to be part of this adventure from September 1, 2023. Dive into the mazes of [b]Labyrinthum[/b], challenge your mind, discover fascinating tales and prepare to be amazed by the infinite possibilities that await you.

Get ready, because adventure awaits you when [b]Labyrinthum[/b] is released in early access on September 1, 2023. Are you ready to take up the challenge and discover the secrets hidden in the twists and turns of this enchanting world?
